fields.name: IPR Checksum
fields.optionalityCitation: v2.8.2 CH16 section 16.4.9.8, footer page 61: the attribute table (p60) prints R, but the definition reads 'Conditional, if Status = "Accepted", then Required, else Not Permitted.' User-defined Table 0571 (CH02C p260), which IPR-4 cites, prints ACK, REJECT, PEND, ADJZER, ADJSUB, ADJ, PAID and PRED and names none of them as Accepted. ADJ, ADJSUB, ADJZER and PAID report an invoice adjudicated for payment, the results the E10 message returns ('paid as submitted, paid partial', 16.3.6 p12), and are Accepted on every reading, so they require IPR-8. ADJZER is among them because the checksum guards an IPR 'before sending to subsequent Payers' (16.4.9.8 p61), and an invoice goes on to a subsequent Payer once 'Edit/Adjudication results have been received from a prior Payer' (16.3.1 rule 1, p3), which a result adjudicated to zero is. REJECT is Accepted on no reading, so it prohibits IPR-8. ACK, PEND and PRED, which is adjudicated 'but will not be paid', are left unchecked. Modelled C (P4-30).
